t: The Stateless Blueprint: Architecting Your Forever Machine with Nix and Jekyll
s: This article argues for building a 'forever machine' by embracing stateless computing principles, specifically Nix for reproducible environments and Jekyll for enduring simplicity, as a path to digital sovereignty and long-term agency against technological obsolescence.
sub: Statelessness vs. Stateful Computing (Lambda Calculus vs. Turing Machines)
Nix as a 'bottling' mechanism for reproducible environments
The Lindy Effect and longevity in technology
AI Safety implications of stateless architectures
Jekyll's role in enduring digital content creation
